args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: service is now healthy with ~0.2% error rate. v2.3.1 requires investigation before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api was unhealthy in all production regions with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was healthy, but only in staging, so it didn't qualify).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) describing the health check failures, the rollback, and current status.

Recommendation: investigate v2.3.1 before attempting any re-deploy.

transcript.reasoning_content: Check deployments, then rollback, then incident.
